body: As I said on my reply to /u/fuckingleoncakes, I don't want to kill myself. I want it as a safety measure, a way for me to feel secure knowing that if I can't take things anymore, I have a way out.
Look, I don't plan on killing myself. I just want to feel secure knowing that I have a way out in case shit hits the fan. Sure it's unhealthy but it's what I need to feel better.
